purpose: Section 17: compute the pre-registered agreement statistics (08-taxonomy-study-preregistration.json) over the three independent blinded adjudicators' results (09/10/11) on the frozen 65-case sample (07), and evaluate the two frozen reproducibility gates. Computed exactly as pre-registered - no formula or threshold changed after seeing these numbers.

pairwiseDetailedAgreement_excludingUnres.note: This is the metric the frozen detailedInterReviewerAgreementGate (08) is computed against.

consensusRule.detailedConsensus: majority (2-of-3) when exactly two agree, else UNRESOLVED_CONSENSUS
consensusRule.note: 4 of the 5 fully-3-way-split cases are exactly the DISCOVERED_ONLY / DISCOVERED_REVIEW_REQUIRED / HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED triangle diagnosed in 13-taxonomy-confusion-analysis.json as the dominant confusion source.

binary.note: Always 100% by construction - binary is a 2-outcome space, a 2-of-3 majority always exists (pre-registered as an uninformative statistic, reported for completeness only).

detailed.note: 60 of 65 cases (92.3%) reached a clean 2-of-3 detailed majority; the remaining 7.7% are the UNRESOLVED_CONSENSUS cases above.

binary.interpretation: Almost-perfect agreement (Landis-Koch scale); not an artifact of category skew - the marginal binary split across all 3 raters combined is roughly 59%/41%, not extreme.

detailed.interpretation: Substantial but not almost-perfect agreement (Landis-Koch scale). Meaningfully lower than the binary kappa, consistent with the raw detailed agreement rate itself sitting below the frozen 85% gate - the chance-adjustment does not rescue the detailed result.

gateEvaluation.verdict: PATH_B: The 12-state taxonomy, as operationalized by 06-taxonomy-operational-rubric.json, is NOT reproducible at the required detailed-agreement threshold (76.7% observed vs. 85% required), despite binary credit/no-credit being highly reproducible (94.9% observed, kappa=0.87). Per Section 19/20, the threshold is NOT lowered. Proceed to ontology/rubric analysis using the confusion-matrix evidence (13-taxonomy-confusion-analysis.json).

falseCreditCrossCheck.purpose: Section 25/08's pre-registered cross-check: do the independent adjudicators also reject all 14 historical confirmed false credits?
falseCreditCrossCheck.note: Every one of the 14 false-credit controls received NO_CREDIT from all three independent adjudicators, unanimously. This is strong independent corroboration that the false-credit determinations from Phase 3F.1.5.2 are correct and that the rubric's binary credit definition is sound - the taxonomy's reproducibility problem is confined to the DETAILED label, not the underlying credit/no-credit judgment.
